caption: The drawing depicts three dark metallic objects, each resembling a type of door latch or handle, arranged vertically side by side against a plain, light beige background. The object on the left features a circular plate at the top with the inscription "COTTERILL'S PATENT" and a central brass or gold-colored accent, extending down into a flat, rectangular base plate with two mounting holes and a small rectangular protrusion at the bottom. The middle object is a long, narrow, and slightly tapered piece, terminating at the top in a broad, flat end, with a small round knob protruding from one side and a rectangular base plate with four mounting holes at the bottom. The object on the right is a slender, elongated bar with a cross-shaped top resembling a clover or four-leaf pattern, with four protruding rounded ends, and a handle that widens at the lower end, featuring a round knob on its side and a rectangular base at the bottom. The overall color scheme is a dark, iron or steel hue with rusty brown and bronzed highlights, and the background is a consistent, lightly mottled cream color.
title: Three Door Latches
